alloy.preparation: Experimental alloy 7580-1; alloys 7580-1 through 7580-4 are stated to be splits from one heat. Detailed manufacture, heat treatment and surface preparation for the reproduced increasing-potential experiments are not restated.

test_solution.preparation: Figure 1 reproduced increasing-potential series in 3.5% NaCl at pH 3. The current-paper increasing-temperature protocol also states 0.6 M NaCl, but its nitrogenation, five-minute waits and temperature ramp are not automatically assigned to the cited scans.

test_method.procedure_description: Reproduced increasing-potential runs at fixed temperature, cited from the earlier presentation (Reference 1) and re-plotted in Figure 2. Potential corresponding to current density 10 µA/cm² used for pit initiation. Scan rate, potential increment and hold duration for those cited runs are not supplied here. The +500 mV hold and 0.6 °C/min temperature ramp belong to a separate temperature-screening test.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Potential at rise in current density to 10 µA/cm²; intermediate temperature-dependent values distinguished from upper transpassive plateau.

experiments.result_note: Source uses potential at 10 μA/cm² as the pit-initiation criterion. Graphical central value and visible vertical endpoints are retained where shown; small adjacent numerals denote run counts, not additional potentials. Upper transpassive-plateau markers are excluded. Cited/reproduced outcome retained with only context supplied by this PDF; no external paper consulted.
